svg.title: Cosmic Library in numbers
svg.desc: Cosmic Library in numbers, counted from the repository when this image was built: 29 interactive pages, 94 equations, 60+ photographs, 110 milestones, 79 documents, 20 hands-on builds, 7 Python simulations. Sources: site/assets/js/codex.js (pages), site/data/equations.json, gallery.json, timeline.json and library.json, the experiments/ folders and simulations/cosmic/. Each counter ticks up from zero beside a small animated icon.
